text.text: NetApp FAS8000 Series

graphic.text: NetApp FAS8000 Series

text.text: Make decisions faster Realize consistent application performance across a broad range of networked storage workloads. NetApp FAS8000 unified scale-out systems boost throughput and decrease latency with a new high-performance, multicore architecture and self-managing flash acceleration. Transition seamlessly into the cloud-enabled software consumption model Leverage simplified management and proven cloud-provider integration, easing the deployment of the Schlumberger BluCube solution in your data center or hybrid cloud. NetApp non-disruptive operations simplify deployment and long-term scaling, improving uptime. Add real-time value to upstream operations Reduce storage capacity requirements and improve long-term return on investment with proven storage efficiency and twice the price/performance of the previous generation. Achieve compatibility with existing networked storage Leverage existing investments in third-party storage arrays using NetApp FlexArray ® storage virtualization software to consolidate them behind the FAS8000.
